approved_scope.title: The workflow-v1 cutoff check finds an archive by the record it holds, not only by a directory name ending in its id
approved_scope.description: The workflow-v1 cutoff check finds an archive by the record it holds, not only by a directory name ending in its id
acceptance_criteria: The cutoff-tree candidates include the archived record's own resolved package path (find_change_dir), as workflow_version_state_paths does, alongside the active path and the cutoff-tree entries ending in -<id>
The persistent cutoff cache and the warm Git-process guards are unchanged; no gate or bound is weakened

cutoff_tree_finds_a_workflow_v1_archive_renamed_before_the_cutoff passes: a workflow-v1 archive moved before the cutoff to a directory not ending in -<id> is accepted by the cutoff-tree check exactly as the history walk accepts it (committed failing first in 14903d0b), and the change loads

cutoff_tree_verdict_equals_the_history_walk_verdict and every existing refusal stay unchanged: a record absent at the cutoff, added after it, or present only under another id is still refused, and a non-canonical -<id> entry still refuses

answers.constraints: SPEED-1.a.2 (a faster read never turns an archived change with intact history into a refusal); REQ-change-136 (cutoff verdict from the cutoff tree, cached by the cutoff) stays; find_change_dir identifies an archive by the id its state declares (cached_archived_history_refuses_a_hidden_downgrade_in_a_renamed_archive); change.3md 'Finalize judges only what it archives' (read paths keep live-identical refusals)
